Station: Bori-police-station (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HA-type ($\rho_1 > \rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4$)
Aquifer depth: 7.44 – 45.0 m
Recommendation: Drill to a total depth of 45.0 m to fully penetrate the main saturated horizon (Layer 3) without advancing into the resistive basal unit. Install borehole screens within the 15.0 – 42.0 m interval with an appropriate gravel pack for optimal groundwater yield.

Station: Court-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AKH
Aquifer depth: 62.9 – 114.0 m
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum depth of 115–120 m to fully tap the thick, low-to-moderate resistivity aquifer in layer 4. Install well screens within the 65–110 m interval with proper gravel packing to ensure optimal yield and prevent sand ingress.

Station: Gokana-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HAA
Aquifer depth: 17.4 – 50.9 m
Recommendation: Drill to a terminal depth of approximately 48–50 m to exploit the thick, permeable sand formation (Layer 4) without penetrating the highly resistive basement at 50.9 m. Install well screens within the 20–45 m interval to optimize groundwater yield and ensure proper gravel packing.

Station: Kogam-street (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HAA
Aquifer depth: 27.7 – 57.3 m
Recommendation: Drill to a terminal depth of at least 60 m to fully penetrate the sandy aquifer unit delineated between 27.7 m and 57.3 m. Install proper well screens and a gravel pack across this zone to optimize yield and prevent sand pumping.

Station: Kor-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: HK
Aquifer depth: > 111 m
Recommendation: Drill to a target depth of at least 120–130 m to adequately penetrate the lower-resistivity aquifer unit identified in Layer 4. Install casing and position well screens within the water-bearing zone below 111 m with appropriate gravel packing.

Station: Market-road (Bori Metropolis)
Curve type: AAK
Aquifer depth: 29.9 – 54.6 m
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum depth of 60 m to fully penetrate the highly prospective, medium-to-coarse sand aquifer delineated between 29.9 m and 54.6 m. Install screens within the 30–54 m depth interval alongside appropriate gravel packing to ensure optimum yield and sand-free water production.

Station: Choba-LawnTennisField (Lawn Tennis Field, University of Port Harcourt, Choba Town)
Curve type: KHA ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4 < \rho_5$)
Aquifer depth: 38.73 – 71.78 m (extending into layer 5)
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum total depth of 75–80 m to tap the highly prospective, medium-to-coarse sand aquifer delineated from 38.7 m downward. Screen intervals should be set within the clean sand zone between 45 m and 70 m with adequate gravel packing.

Station: Egwi
Curve type: AAA-type ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 < \rho_3 < \rho_4 < \rho_5$)
Aquifer depth: 6.3 – 44.3 m
Recommendation: Drill to a terminal depth of 45–50 m to fully exploit the high-resistivity saturated sand unit of Layer 4. Install well screens within the 15–40 m zone accompanied by proper gravel packing to ensure optimum yield and sand-free water production.

Station: Odufor
Curve type: AK
Aquifer depth: > 17.04 m
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum depth of 45 to 60 m to fully penetrate the saturated sand aquifer identified from 17.04 m depth downward. Ensure installation of standard screen and gravel pack within the basal aquiferous formation to optimize groundwater yield.

Station: Opiro
Curve type: KH ($\rho_1 < \rho_2 > \rho_3 < \rho_4$)
Aquifer depth: > 21.6 m
Recommendation: Drill to a minimum target depth of 45–50 m to tap the productive saturated sand horizon in Layer 4. Install casing with screen placement and adequate gravel packing below 25 m to prevent fine sand ingress and optimize yield.
